children: Taiwan has become the largest market in the MSCI Emerging Markets Index, overtaking offshore China, according to Goldman Sachs research, as posted by
Taiwan currently accounts for 27% of the MSCI EM index, according to the Goldman Sachs chart.

The chart tracked the market that held the largest weight in the index at each point, with the colored bands changing as leadership shifted. It does not show the individual weights of markets during periods when they were not the largest.

The data showed China holding the largest market weight through a much longer stretch, with its weight reaching a peak of 43%. The post, however, said offshore China held the top spot from 2008 until the first quarter of 2016.

Other markets have previously held the top position. Malaysia reached a weight of 33% during an earlier period, while Mexico reached 31% and Korea reached 24%. The chart also showed Brazil holding the largest market weight during another period.
